inputs.question: On the site plan, identify all sidewalk locations. For each transformer pad shown, determine whether there are sidewalks adjacent to or near the transformer pad. If sidewalks are present, measure the distance from the back (edge closest to the transformer pad) of the sidewalk to the edge of the transformer pad. Indicate whether these distances meet or exceed 2 feet.
inputs.checklistItemText: Transformer pads not located minimum 2 feet from back of sidewalks
inputs.classifierReasoning: The agent question explicitly asks to 'measure the distance from the back of the sidewalk to the edge of the transformer pad' and determine compliance with a 2-foot minimum clearance requirement, which is a direct distance/clearance measurement task despite the multi-step framing.
